questions.question: What GPA is required for automatic first-year admission?
questions.gold_answer: A 2.75 GPA is required for automatic first-year admission.
questions.citation: “Automatic Admission – Requires a cumulative high school GPA of 2.75 or higher.”

questions.gold_answer: A GPA between 2.5 and 2.75 is required for conditional admission.
questions.citation: “Conditional Admission – GPA between 2.5 and 2.75.”

questions.question: What GPA is required for automatic transfer admission?
questions.gold_answer: A 2.0 GPA with 16+ transferable credits is required.
questions.citation: “Automatic Admission – Requires a cumulative GPA of 2.0 or higher… 16 transferable credits.”
